Class Rook

java.lang.Object
chess.pieces.Piece
chess.pieces.Rook
public class Rook extends Piece
A rook: moves any number of squares along a rank or file. Intervening squares must be empty (enforced by Piece.canMoveTo(Position, Board)).

This class is the fully worked example of a piece subclass. Use it as the model for the other five.
